Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D action RPG VFX animation atlas, genuine transparent RGBA. Output landscape 1536x1024, precisely FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, twelve frames ordered left to right then top to bottom. Each cell has a fixed identical camera, scale, pivot and at least 8 percent transparent padding on all sides. No borders, grid lines, labels, numbers, characters, weapons, scenery or UI. These are actual consecutive animation drawings, with shape, energy flow, debris and light developing over time, NOT twelve duplicates. Crisp hand-painted anime game VFX, very high energy and graphic clarity. FAT luminous ribbons, strong saturated color, white-hot sharpened edges and colored interior mass; layered dynamic curved forms. Much more substantial than thin scratches. Glow must not be a flat opaque rectangle; real clean alpha between effect forms. The provided reference is inspiration for force, thickness and rich layered energy, not a background to reproduce.
Primary request: TWELVE consecutive frames of a huge ground-skimming GOLD AND WHITE DRAGON SHAPED SWORD ENERGY WAVE sweeping LEFT TO RIGHT. Wide horizontal silhouette, the front of the effect at the RIGHT is a recognizable fierce dragon head made from white-hot gold energy with long horns, open sharp jaws and streaming whiskers. Its long serpentine body loops into TWO thick interweaving orange-gold helixes behind it, with small cyan razor accents. Powerful painterly molten-gold ribbons hug the ground; raised gravel, flying stone splinters and golden pressure dust define the grounded footprint. Match the overwhelming ground swirl in the reference, with a more legible dragon silhouette. No actual creature body, legs or wings: a dragon DRAWN by flowing sword energy. All frames share one fixed ground level at 82% of cell height and a fixed overall framing. Frames 1-3: crescent opening from the left, dragon head coheres and body spirals tightly. Frames 4-6: full wide dragon charge, jaws and horns sharp at right, thick layered coils and luminous central slash bridge all the way back left. Frames 7-9: head breaks into explosive jagged sweeping gold tongues, coils extend forward and stone debris lifts. Frames 10-12: stretched trailing gold curls, fragments and scattered sparks fade. Do NOT draw a vertical downward meteor, aerial slam or circular magic seal. Peak ribbons occupy a large continuous area, not just hairlines.
